channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-42271 — BerriAI LiteLLM
item.description: Threat Signal 78. BerriAI LiteLLM contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow any authenticated user, including holders of low-privilege internal-user keys, to run arbitrary commands on the host.

item.title: CVE-2026-63077 — JetBrains TeamCity
item.description: Threat Signal 92. JetBrains TeamCity contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution via the agent polling protocol.

item.title: CVE-2025-43300 — Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Image I/O framework.

item.title: CVE-2026-85102 — Check Point Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall using Site to Site VPN or Remote Access VPN contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway.

item.title: CVE-2014-2120 — Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA)
item.description: Threat Signal 57. Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the WebVPN login page. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to inject arbitrary web script or HTML via an unspecified parameter.

item.title: CVE-2026-65660 — Microsoft SharePoint
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-87902 — WordPress Core
item.description: Threat Signal 70. WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2010-1297 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Adobe Flash Player contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2026-67279 — MikroTik RouterOS
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.
